summary.text: Mishael White is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 81 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Noelle Kahaian (R).
In a Ballotpedia survey, his campaign materials describe him as a truck driver and real estate investor who moved to Georgia from New Orleans in 2005.

paragraphs.text: Mishael White was born in New Orleans, Louisiana, according to Ballotpedia, and has been affiliated with the Henry County Democratic Party.
In a Ballotpedia survey, his materials say he relocated to Georgia from New Orleans in 2005 after Hurricane Katrina, and describe him as a husband of 23 years, father of six and grandfather of two.

The survey lists his education as American Online High School, his professional experience as truck driver and real estate investor, and his political experience as volunteer work on the Barack Obama campaign in 2009.
White wrote that his campaign focuses on clean, safe schools, care for the elderly and sick including expanding Medicaid, infrastructure such as roads and bridges, and healthcare.
